criteria.category: A. Product architecture and manufacturing assumptions

criteria.category: A. Product architecture and manufacturing assumptions

criteria.category: A. Product architecture and manufacturing assumptions

criteria.tradeoff: Commonality can add material cost or coupled supply risk.

criteria.category: B. BOM, materials and controlled substitutions

criteria.category: B. BOM, materials and controlled substitutions

criteria.category: B. BOM, materials and controlled substitutions

criteria.category: B. BOM, materials and controlled substitutions

criteria.category: C. Bare PCB fabrication
criteria.requirement: Specify a reproducible board construction.

criteria.category: C. Bare PCB fabrication

criteria.required_evidence: Finished trace/space/hole/annular-ring requirements; drill/via types, plating and aspect ratio; tolerance-sensitive features reviewed at process corners.

criteria.category: C. Bare PCB fabrication

criteria.category: C. Bare PCB fabrication

criteria.tradeoff: A slot or coating changes fabrication, cleaning and inspection burdens.

criteria.category: C. Bare PCB fabrication
criteria.requirement: Design the manufacturing panel and separation route deliberately.
